oai_qdc:qualifieddc.dc:title: Catalog of Philander Smith College, 1916-1917
oai_qdc:qualifieddc.dc:creator: Philander Smith University
oai_qdc:qualifieddc.dc:description: This is Philander Smith College's (PSC) 1916-1917 catalog, which includes PSC's history, admission requirements, and rules and regulations. The catalog also features lists of faculty and students and courses of study for the College Preparatory and Teachers' Normal Training schools. It also includes course and supply lists for first through eighth-grade students.
oai_qdc:qualifieddc.dc:subject: African American students; African American universities and colleges; Campus life; Faculty and staff; African American teachers
